scope: Under the original one-NOT hypotheses, at most one deficient heavy C1 private class implies the stronger weighted inequality <=C.size+m, for every window size and outsider count. Therefore any failure of the exact L-meta-997 refund conclusion requires at least two deficient heavy classes. The unrestricted target remains open.
mathematical_audit: Only heavy private deficiencies are counted. Light targets always use their min(k,d)-1 window quota.
The lone heavy residual is paid by all outside-wide gates using compensated_private_count, and the private/outside unions are disjoint.
The original-circuit bridge uses the same-index true-NOT replacement. Windows of size<=2 use the already checked SmallWindow theorem.
Empty/singleton targets and malformed reads remain permitted; no extra well-formedness premise is introduced.
